expected.title: Sharp two-sided heat-kernel estimates for isotropic stable SDEs with uniformly nondegenerate Hölder diffusion and locally Hölder linearly growing drift
expected.author: Stéphane Menozzi; Xicheng Zhang
expected.difficulty_reason: The cited weak well-posedness theorem supplies a process, not sharp stable-tail density bounds for an unbounded supercritical drift. Sections2–3 construct scale-dependent drift flows, close singular parametrix convolutions and derive the off-diagonal lower estimate by a controlled Lévy-system jump. Section5 then preserves these uniform estimates under coefficient smoothing and drift truncation; the new estimates remain required after the named probabilistic foundations are allowed.
